title: Use licensed electricians for North Dakota electrical contracting work
description: A business planning, installing, altering or repairing electrical wiring or equipment in North Dakota must ensure the work is performed by appropriately licensed electricians. The State Electrical Board rules provide master, journeyman, Class B and apprentice credentials, with annual renewal requirements and separate application fees by credential.
renewal: Renew the applicable electrician license or registration annually by the credential's expiration date; the rules list April 30 for master and Class B licenses, March 31 for journeyman licenses, and January 31 for apprentice registrations.
